summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for CarMax Select Receivables Trust 2026-B, an auto-loan ABS issuance totaling $546,371,000 across six note tranches. The offering is a routine asset-backed securitization, not a special situation. The notes are secured by motor vehicle retail installment contracts, with credit enhancement via subordination, overcollateralization, a reserve account, and excess collections. Interest is paid monthly starting July 15, 2026, with sequential principal paydown by seniority. The depositor retains at least 5% of each class for credit risk retention. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation category applies.
